label: On RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_1 receiving entails giving and present receipt is concurrent actualization
paraphrase: Closed definitional result, attribution deferred: for every history, giving relation and reception predicate, when present-tense receipt is read as passion (passionReceipt, RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_1: z receives x's esse at t iff x's esse is received in z and something gives x being at t), correlativity of receiving and giving holds, and the present-tense reading of reception is equivalent to weak concurrent actualization 40a97664. So on this sense the present-tense reading is 40a97664 restated, not a further premise; it adds no warrant beyond whatever warrant 40a97664 has.
